affected_predicate.description: The selected Mastodon account's language is set to Chinese Simplified.

competing_trace_defects.description: While intending to dismiss the Appearance dialog, the action selected Light and visibly changed the appearance setting from Use device appearance to Light, an unrelated configuration change.
Two consecutive downward drags on the fully visible account-settings page produced no UI change and did not advance toward a language control.
The trajectory opened About this server even though its visible description was limited to overview, rules, and moderators; the resulting server-information page exposed no account-language control.

chains.rationale: At the reuse target, the model explicitly recognized that the earlier account-management interpretation had not produced the expected screen and used the Home-screen gear to return to Settings. It then re-entered the owner account settings, performed two static scrolls, and opened About this server. No visible action selected Chinese Simplified, and every observable interface through the last screenshot remained in English. The reused observation was therefore concurrent with the later unsuccessful search rather than an observed harmful bridge to the language predicate.

summary: The sole strict-MHR reuse target visibly corrected course by reopening Settings and shows no harmful bridge from the reused account-screen description to the language predicate. Independently observable defects include an unintended appearance change, repeated static scrolling, and navigation to server information. No supplied screenshot shows Chinese Simplified selected or the account interface changed from English.
